Description: VPCs found without a Network Firewall.
Risk: Without a Network Firewall, it is a lot harder to filter incoming traffic, which limits the detection of possible attacks.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure Network Firewall is enabled for all VPCs' traffic. This will allow active detection and blocking of malicious traffic through domain filtering, packet inspection, signature-based detection and other measures able to be set up across VPCs and Availability Zones.
